final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor presented no new admissible evidence. The response usefully narrows the claim: the current record may support a caveated launch-readiness narrative at an aggregate level, but that is not the same as satisfying the compliance predicate in the policy text. Under the policy, certification without material caveats requires either evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. That condition is still unmet. The Actor correctly concedes that clean certification is unsupported and that the draft mitigation does not remove the disclosure requirement, but there is still no evidence that disclosure has actually been corrected or that approved risk acceptance exists before launch. Because the narrowing is an interpretation of the same evidence rather than new support, the packet remains a plausible but unresolved compliance case rather than a supported compliant_with_caveats outcome.
